summary: Replaced the legacy API regression test with four passing authentication, authorization-isolation, token-rejection, password-storage, and frontend-auth smoke tests.

messages.content: Sprint 3 QA passed: 4 regression tests cover registration/login, stored password derivation, protected CRUD, cross-user isolation, tampered and expired token rejection, plus the frontend authentication integration markers.

decisions: Tests use an in-process handler harness and temporary SQLite database, avoiding network sockets while exercising the real request handlers and schema.
The test fixture supplies KANBAN_JWT_SECRET explicitly so authentication tests do not rely on a developer-machine secret.
